cases.name: child-approval-approve
cases.normalization: Interaction IDs become pause-N; one child approval resumes after approving its parent delegate.

cases.name: child-approval-reject
cases.normalization: Interaction IDs become pause-N; denying the parent delegate abandons the child without a write.

cases.name: child-approval-restore
cases.normalization: Interaction IDs become pause-N; native reload serializes Conversation and Node uses two Worker lifetimes.

limits: Scripted replies only. One hoisted child with one approval and no external calls; child calls must be present in interaction props. Nested hoists, several hoisting children in a tool body, child streams and Chromium are outside this suite. Node crash-after-write replay of a hoisted resume is unmeasured.
